decisions.reason: Although it has not recently appeared as a distinct website item, encrypted second-channel communication remains close to the firm's core identity and trusted communication stack, so keeping it open still offers strategic value at likely modest incremental cost.

Mobile PDF signing fits the firm's secure contracting and cross-channel identity direction, but after several years its standalone market potential looks more bounded, so it is kept with a meaningful review risk.

A multi-layer end-to-end security architecture is a core enabling capability for the firm's broader platform, so even if marketed less explicitly, its strategic value is high and abandonment is unlikely.

As a more specific communication application with no recent visible market evidence, this option now appears to have yielded enough information to justify reallocating resources to stronger core and new development opportunities.
